description: One inverter option on a package, with what the package costs built that way. The same array is quoted with a string inverter, with panel-level optimisers and with microinverters - three prices, one package.

fields.description: How this inverter is built: on strings, strings with optimisers, micro inverters, or hybrid. The default option's is the package's.
fields.label: Inverter Topology
fields.options:
String
String with Optimiser
Microinverter
Hybrid

fields.description: The inverter, from the Inverters item group. Choosing it fills the specification.
fields.label: Inverter Item

fields.description: From the inverter price list: fills the make, size, phase, specification and rate.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Takes the model's optimizers at the price list's quantity.
fields.label: With Optimizer

fields.description: The connection this inverter is for. An estimate offers only the inverters of its own phase. Left blank, it is the package's connection type.
fields.label: Phase

fields.description: The panel this option is quoted with, when it is not the package's default panel (a microinverter option on panels of its own). Blank: the default panel.
fields.label: Built with Panel

fields.description: Worked out on save from the Pricing Options: the package built with this inverter on its panel (Built with Panel, else the default) and the default battery. Read by the estimate and the proposal.
fields.label: Cost

fields.description: What one inverter costs. A design estimate's inverter row with no rate of its own is priced at this. The whole system's price with this inverter is on the Pricing Options tab.
fields.label: Rate per Inverter

fields.description: The option quoted unless another is chosen. Exactly one row carries it.
fields.label: Default
